title: Explain browser API failures
responsibility: Map known API failure codes to readable wording without exposing unknown server messages.

inputs.name: browserError.code
inputs.description: The API failure code matched against this module’s known-code mapping; codes outside its own keys receive only generic status or unreachable wording, without server details.

inputs.name: browserError.status
inputs.description: The numeric request status consulted only for an unrecognized code; a truthy value is interpolated in the generic failure, while a falsy value selects the server-unreachable wording.

outputs.name: browserError
outputs.description: The user-readable explanation returned for the code; known codes use fixed wording, while unknown codes reveal no server message and fall back to status or unreachable wording.
examples: The server could not be reached.
